hooks.text: 每局先选一名规则独特的船长，再围绕专属效果组队
hooks.excerpt: Begin each game by selecting a Captain with its own unique effect. Will you choose Dorothy to help complete her friends’ quests? Or Dragonmother to discover what hatches from her Mysterious Egg?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 先摆位、算回合，再看童话角色阵容自动对战
hooks.excerpt: Recruit characters and cast spells each round to prepare for your next challenge. Carefully position your cards while planning your turn—then enjoy their auto-battle against other captains and crews!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 无倒计时异步挑战真人历史阵容，也可开6人实时房
hooks.excerpt: No timers, no pressure. Galaxy's matchmaking and async-multiplayer mean you can battle fun-but-challenging opponents whenever you want. Face real boards from other human players’ earlier games. Your finished run will join the opponent pool for others to challenge.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
